title: Cymbals and triangle
description: Suspended cymbal, triangle and bass drum, each on its own chair through the unpitched percussion bridge: cymbal rolls under hairpins, triangle and bass-drum hits with accents, and a bass-drum roll. Each part binds to its chair's instrument; rolls take CC1, hits take velocity. The bass drum part is named Gran Cassa: Dorico's MusicXML import wraps each unpitched part in a kit whose component names match the part name, and 'Bass Drum' matches its eight-drum marching bass drums kit, which the template cannot route.
